roots.origin: 拉丁语 edere（交出、发表），由 ex（出）＋ dare（给）合成，过去分词 editus；拉丁语另有同形的 edere（吃）与此无关，故本项目词根 id 加 -publish 后缀区分
roots.core_concept: to give a thing out to the public / 把东西整治好、交出去给众人
roots.core_image: 一叠稿子经人逐页勾划删补，理齐了才递出门去
roots.english_definition: to give out, put forth, publish

roots.origin: 拉丁语 tangere（触、碰到），过去分词 tactus；attingere（ad＋tangere）表「伸手够到」，经古法语 ataindre 成英语 attain。英语拼作 -tain 是后来与 contain/obtain 类推所致，源头与 tenere（握）另有分别
roots.core_concept: to reach far enough to touch a thing / 伸出去，刚好碰到那一点
roots.core_image: 指尖向上伸，最后一寸终于搭上了崖沿

roots.origin: 拉丁语 peior（更坏的，malus 的比较级），晚期拉丁语 impejorare（使变更坏）经古法语 empeirier 成英语 impair；与 par（相等）一支的 pair/repair 无关
roots.core_concept: to make a thing worse than it was / 把原本好的弄得更差一层
roots.core_image: 一块完好的板子被磕出缺口，往后每次用都差一点

concepts.concept: to give a thing out to the public
concepts.core_image: 稿子逐页勾划删补，理齐了才递出门去

concepts.concept: to reach far enough to touch a thing
concepts.core_image: 指尖向上伸，最后一寸搭上了崖沿

concepts.concept: to make a thing worse than it was
concepts.core_image: 完好的板子被磕出缺口，往后每次用都差一点

words.root_logic: edere（交出、发布）→ 为交出去而先把文字勾划整治一遍
words.origin: 英语 edit 由 editor 反向构词而来，源头是拉丁语 edere（交出、发表）
words.native_definition: to prepare written work for publication by correcting and cutting it
words.core_concept: working over a text so it is fit to be handed out – 把文字整治到可以交出去的程度
words.core_image: 红笔在稿子上圈掉一段，又在空白处补了两行
examples: She edits a weekly magazine.
He edited the footage down to ten minutes.
semantic_expansions: 编辑/校订：为交出去而整治文字
剪辑：把影像同样整治成可交出的一版
words.recall_hint: edere（交出）→ 为交出去而先整治一遍

words.root_logic: edit（整治交出）+ -or（人）→ 负责整治并定稿交出的人
words.origin: 拉丁语 editor（交出者、发表者），来自 edere
words.native_definition: a person who prepares and decides the content of a publication
words.core_concept: the one who works a text over and decides it may go out – 把稿子整治定稿、点头放行的人
words.core_image: 他把最后一页放下，签了字，稿子这才准许送印
examples: The editor rejected the article.
She is editor of the local paper.
semantic_expansions: 编辑/主编：整治稿件并定稿放行的人
words.recall_hint: edit（整治交出）+ -or（人）→ 定稿放行的那个人

words.root_logic: editor（定稿人）+ -ial（…的）→ 属于定稿人立场的；名词指报社表态的那篇
words.origin: 英语 editorial，来自 editor ← 拉丁语 edere
words.native_definition: relating to the editing of a publication; an article giving a paper's opinion
words.core_concept: belonging to the one who decides what goes out – 属于那位定稿放行者的
words.core_image: 头版下方那一栏不署名，说的是整家报社的立场
examples: She joined the editorial team.
The paper ran an editorial on the strike.
semantic_expansions: 编辑的：属于定稿放行者职务的
社论：由定稿方出面表态的那一篇
words.recall_hint: editor（定稿人）+ -ial → 属于定稿放行者的

words.root_logic: edere（交出、发布）+ -ition → 一次交出去的那一批，即某一版
words.origin: 拉丁语 editio（发表、发行），来自 edere（交出）
words.native_definition: a particular issue or version of a book, paper, or broadcast
words.core_concept: one batch as it was given out that time – 那一回交出去的那一批
words.core_image: 扉页上印着第三回付印的字样，内容与头一回已有出入
examples: This is the second edition of the book.
The evening edition sold out.
semantic_expansions: 版本/版次：某一回交出去的那一批
一期：报刊按次交出的其中一份
words.recall_hint: edere（交出）+ -ition → 一次交出去的那一批

words.root_logic: at-（ad- 靠向）+ tain（触及）→ 一路伸手过去，终于够到
words.origin: 古法语 ataindre，来自拉丁语 attingere（触及）← ad＋tangere（触）；英语拼作 -tain 受 contain/obtain 类推影响，词源仍在 tangere 一支
words.native_definition: to succeed in reaching or achieving something after effort
words.core_concept: stretching until the fingers finally close on it – 一直伸，直到指尖终于搭上
words.core_image: 指尖一寸寸往上探，最后扣住了崖顶那道边沿
examples: She attained the rank of captain.
Few attain such skill so young.
semantic_expansions: 达到/实现：一路伸手过去终于够到
获得：够到之后归入自己手里
words.recall_hint: at-（靠向）+ tain（触及）→ 伸手过去终于够到

words.root_logic: im-（in- 使）+ pair（更坏）→ 使某物比原先更差 → 损害
words.origin: 古法语 empeirier，来自晚期拉丁语 impejorare（使变坏）← in＋peior（更坏）；与 pair（一对，来自 par 相等）不同源
words.native_definition: to weaken or damage something, especially a faculty or ability
words.core_concept: knocking a sound thing down a notch so it works less well – 把本来好的磕掉一层，从此不如原先
words.core_image: 完好的板面被磕出一道缺口，再用就总差着那一点
examples: Loud noise can impair your hearing.
Fatigue impaired his judgement.
semantic_expansions: 损害/削弱：把本来好的弄差一层
使受损：功能被磕缺后不如原先
words.recall_hint: im-（使）+ pair（更坏）→ 使之比原先更差

words.root_logic: influenza 的截短：in-（进入）+ flu（流）→ 流进体内的那股病气
words.origin: 英语 flu 是意大利语 influenza 的截短形；influenza ← 拉丁语 influentia ← influere（in＋fluere 流入），旧时以为疾病由星辰之气「流入」人身
words.native_definition: a common illness caused by a virus, with fever and aching
words.core_concept: the sickness once thought to flow into the body from outside – 旧时认为自外流进体内的那股病气
words.core_image: 一屋子人接连倒下，像有什么顺着空气淌进了身体
examples: She caught the flu last winter.
Half the office is off with flu.
semantic_expansions: 流感/流行性感冒：旧说自外流进体内的那股病气
words.recall_hint: influenza 截短 → in-（进入）+ flu（流）→ 流进体内的病气

words.root_logic: premere（压、按）→ 用力压下去；引申为压印出版的那一行，即报界
words.origin: 古法语 presser，来自拉丁语 pressare ← premere（压、按）
words.native_definition: to push firmly on something; also newspapers and journalists collectively
words.core_concept: bearing down on a thing with steady force – 稳稳使力压在物上
words.core_image: 掌根压在纸面上，油墨透过版子印了上去；报馆的机器整夜这样压着
examples: Press the button to start.
The press gathered outside the court.
semantic_expansions: 按/压：稳稳使力压在物上
报界/新闻界：靠压印机器出版的那一行
words.recall_hint: premere（压、按）→ 使力压下；压印成版即报界

words.root_logic: scribere（写、刻画）的过去分词 scriptum → 写下来的那份文字
words.origin: 拉丁语 scriptum（写成之物），scribere（写）的过去分词中性形
words.native_definition: the written text of a play or film; a system of writing
words.core_concept: the thing as it stands written down – 已经写下来、定在纸面上的那份
words.core_image: 演员手里那几页纸被翻得起了毛边，台词全在上面
examples: He is writing a film script.
The inscription uses an ancient script.
semantic_expansions: 剧本/脚本：写下来供照着演的那份文字
字体：文字写下来所用的那套形体
words.recall_hint: scribere（写）的过去分词 → 已写下定在纸面的那份

words.root_logic: re-（回）+ fer（带）+ -ence → 把话头带回某处去 → 提及、依据
words.origin: 英语 reference 来自 refer ← 拉丁语 referre（带回、归于）← re＋ferre（带）
words.native_definition: a mention of something; a source consulted; a letter about someone's ability
words.core_concept: carrying the matter back to the place it came from – 把话头带回它的出处
words.core_image: 他讲到一半停下，翻回书后那一栏，指着出处给人看
examples: She made no reference to the delay.
Please list your references at the end.
semantic_expansions: 参考：把话头带回出处去核对
推荐信：把某人来历带回给对方看的那封
words.recall_hint: re-（回）+ fer（带）→ 把话头带回它的出处
